summary:
I wrote plan.md for the Capitol. It runs north to south and mirrors exactly about z 47.5: Senate wing (z 2..18), connector, central block (x 10..29), connector, House wing (z 77..93). All balustrades sit at y 12, with arcaded rusticated basements, long west colonnades, pedimented east porticos, an arcaded West Front with double flights of steps, and a staggered double-row East Portico.
The dome is laid out on even-diameter rings around x 20, z 48 and climbs to y 41: square base, a 16-wide peristyle of about 24 columns with a lit drum behind, a 14-wide attic, a 12-wide bell shell with 8 grey ribs, a 4-wide lantern, and a dark Statue of Freedom on top. That puts the dome about 3x the wing height, as on the real building.
The palette is white quartz, calcite and diorite with teal copper cupolas; the lit drum, lantern and skylights glow warm at dusk. Unchecked: nothing has been built or rendered, and the broad east steps fall outside the plot. White neoclassical Capitol symmetric about z 47.5: two balustraded wings with west colonnades and east pedimented porticoes, a central block with the West Front loggia and East Portico, and the stepped peristyle, ribbed bell dome, tholos and bronze Freedom statue (y41) on the d16/d12/d4 rings.
Exterior-only solid core (spawn-proof), warm glowstone and lanterns at the base and in the drum, lantern and skylights for dusk. elements.md and plan.md (PALETTE, VOCABULARY, ROOMS, PARTS) are written; all block ids are 1.21.1-valid.

recruit.why: Rusticated podium, 2-thick walls, quoin-like piers, arches and worked courses.
Columns, entablatures, pediments with raked stairs, balustrades.
Round courses on exact rings, stepped bell with stair edges, ribs, tholos, statue.
Recessed panes, lintels, double bronze doors with transoms.
Warm floodlit base, lit drum, lantern, and spawn-proof lighting.
